Alright! Here is the video description:
The video features Theo, a Black man, talking about his life between Rwanda and the Netherlands. Initially, he is sitting on a grey couch with the flags of Rwanda and the Netherlands beside him. He is wearing a white t-shirt with the text "theoisback" in a YouTube logo style on it and beige pants. His expression is serious and focused as he speaks. The video then transitions to a Google Maps view highlighting the location of the Netherlands in Europe, along with quick facts about the country displayed. Further, images of Theo and his family, friends, and business follow. There are shots of him receiving an award, standing with acquaintances, and riding a horse and a motorcycle. There are scenes from his gym, K1GA11 FIT, in Rwanda. They feature him wearing a lime green shirt, coaching a group of people. Then, a brief montage of people exercising in his gym is shown. Visual changes include transitions between indoor and outdoor scenes, from personal photos to professional settings.
